title: Bug 642180: DE report 11015 Export Business Data fails when scheduled via Job Queue: Client callbacks are not supported
summary: Report 11015 Export Business Data now stores generated ZIP files in the Report Inbox when scheduled via Job Queue instead of attempting a client callback that fails in background sessions.
key_points: Background sessions can no longer directly download files to clients
Generated ZIP files are now stored in Report Inbox for scheduled runs
Interactive report execution continues to download files directly as before
Users can retrieve scheduled exports from the Report Inbox
Aligns scheduled report behavior with existing layout report patterns
